name: DUMBBELL UPRIGHT-ROW
introduce: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your body. Keep your palms towards your body. \n\nLift your hands straight up until your hands are under your chin, then lower them. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare two dumbbells that you feel comfortable with.
Exhale as you raise your hands, and inhale as you lower them.
